clock.assumption: Same boot; no router suspend; constant wall-to-uptime offset compatible with bracketed samples.

limits: PS sequence gaps exclude continuous PS-duration claims. Independent WCID reads are host snapshots, not atomic air state.
No observed P event does not establish no unlogged transition, particularly beyond the final sequence.
F means status1 report, not a successful air transmission or delivery timestamp.
Server TCP intervals are relative to its test; no independent server wall-clock calibration.
Clock offset width is separate from the wider traffic-start bracket; neither proves air-event latency.
PPE bypass still uses active NPU DMA. These tests do not isolate an NPU-free path.
No scan/channel evidence or NPU/WA internal occupancy; no driver fix inferred.
